title: tf-github repo config (repos/<name>.yaml)
description: Authoritative schema for the config-as-code surface read by terraform/repositories.tf. Every legal top-level key must be listed in $defs.repoFields.properties; additionalProperties: false means a misspelled key fails validation instead of silently defaulting away via try(...).

profile.description: Name of a profile defined in repos/_defaults.yaml. Its keys are merged in as defaults; any key also set explicitly in this file overrides the profile's value.

type.description: Set to "custom" to route through the hand-rolled custom_repos resources in repositories.tf instead of the repo module (used for melvyndekort.github.io, which needs GitHub Pages support the repo module does not provide; see README.md#custom-repos).

aws_account.description: 12-digit AWS account id. Presence triggers creation of a github-actions-<repo> OIDC role in that account.

shared_workflows.description: Allow-list melvyndekort/gha-workflows reusable workflows for this repo's GitHub Actions.

aws_plan_role.description: Create an additional read-only github-actions-<repo>-plan OIDC role, trust-gated to pull_request + the shared plan workflow's job_workflow_ref, and distribute AWS_PLAN_ROLE_ARN.

aws_plan_kms_target.description: Encryption-context `target` value this repo's plan role may kms:Decrypt on the shared generic KMS key. Must match the `target` used in the repo's own secrets.tf.

required_status_checks.description: Status check contexts required before main accepts a merge. Public repos only (repo module); ignored for private repos.

require_pull_request.description: Whether main requires a PR + review + status checks. Default true. Set false ONLY as a temporary, explicitly-tracked migration window (public repos only) -- see repo/variables.tf.

required_review_count.description: Number of approving reviews required on a pull request. Public repos only.

production_environment.description: Create a `production` GitHub Environment on this repo even without shared_workflows (e.g. a repo with its own bespoke apply workflow that still wants the OIDC subject pinned to :environment:production).

name.description: GitHub Actions secret name as it will appear in the repo.

value_ref.description: Key into the merged secret-value map: a local value name, or `tf_cloudflare.<output>` for any tf_cloudflare remote-state output.

archived.description: Whether the repository is archived (read-only). Only ever goes true -> once set, this module stops making writes against the repo.

allowed_actions_config.description: Extra allowed-actions glob patterns beyond the shared_workflows allow-list.

pages.description: custom_repos only: GitHub Pages source branch.

default_branch.description: custom_repos only: default branch to set (e.g. gh-pages).
